edges.label: the named model this domain is arguing about, and the reason to keep it graded Tier 3
edges.note: UAP Gerb's onion model of an indefinitely layered secrecy architecture, set out across two investigations published 1 May and 19 June 2026, is the most fully articulated structural hypothesis in circulation and is what the independent-media substrate has organised itself around.
